description: Checks whether one specific dentist, eye doctor, vet, dermatology or GI practice is private-equity backed, from its name plus city and state or ZIP. A street address or phone number makes the match surer. Also answers for a consumer brand by name or website (e.g. "Orvis" or "orvis.com"), with its owner, backers and sources. Returns a status (match, multiple_matches, possible_matches, no_match, need_location), a "say" sentence in the site's label wording, and matches with label, owner group, backers, PE stake and deal model, confidence, sources (headline, link, date), coverage and a correction link.

address.description: Street address, or a full address like "1476 W Buckingham Rd, Garland, TX 75040".

industry.description: dental, eye (optometry, ophthalmology, optical), vet, derm, gi, or brand (a consumer brand). Leave out to infer it from the name.

name.description: Business name as the user or a map listing gives it, e.g. "Aspen Dental" or "Smile Magic of Garland".

state.description: Two-letter state code (TX) or state name.

name: lookup_business
title: Is this business PE-backed?
